raw_segments.text: Cassio, I but by your leave not before me, the lieutenant is to be saved before the ancient.
Let's have no more of this, let's to our affairs.
Gentlemen, let's look to our business.
Do not think, gentlemen, I am drunk.
This is my ancient, this is my right hand, and this is my left.
I can stand well enough and I speak well enough.
